mode_catalog.name: Ordinary walking
mode_catalog.access_rules: No unlock; public safe-service approaches available immediately.
mode_catalog.constraints: Fatigue, slope, visibility and shelter constrain travel.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Marked towpaths and terrace paths remain the universal baseline.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Ordinary roads
mode_catalog.access_rules: No Oath; foot priority at crossings.
mode_catalog.constraints: Road inspection may narrow lanes.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Raised local foot path or registered alternate regional road.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Bridges and causeways
mode_catalog.access_rules: Posted load class; no alignment or reputation gate.
mode_catalog.constraints: Scour, surge, overload and inspection close a specific deck.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Separate upstream relief crossing or edge-removal detour, never same failed support.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Mountain passes
mode_catalog.access_rules: Weather briefing and ordinary clothing available through relief services.
mode_catalog.constraints: Avalanche, lightning and whiteout suspend main pass.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Lower sheltered trail or non-pass regional detour.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Climbing paths
mode_catalog.access_rules: Optional equipment/tutorial; auto-assist usable; not required for story access.
mode_catalog.constraints: Handhold ice, rockfall and rescue limits.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Ramp or stair road around the cliff; climbing never essential.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: River ferries and barges
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public boarding; marked potable/non-potable water and reach class.
mode_catalog.constraints: Low flow, flood, weirs and tide separate navigable reaches.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Parallel road; upstream towing only in surveyed low-gradient reaches.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Canals and locks
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public lock schedule; contaminant cargo sealed and separately inspected.
mode_catalog.constraints: Silt, lock power, water budget and treatment isolation.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Towpath and dry transfer quay; no canal assumed through the continental divide.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Coastal maritime routes
mode_catalog.access_rules: Mainland quay access and weather advisory; no essential isolated islands.
mode_catalog.constraints: Surge, visibility and loading windows.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Entire land network remains available; coastwise ferry is supplemental.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Gliding routes
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public trained operator; optional personal rig; inspect landing before launch.
mode_catalog.constraints: Crosswind, downdraft and fog; directional not freely reversible.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Ground switchback returns uphill; catch platforms and short abort landing.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Underground passages
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public audited tunnel only; ventilation and flood clearance.
mode_catalog.constraints: Gas, collapse, groundwater and structural inspection.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Surface route on a separate slope; no forced cave crossing.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Mount and pack paths
mode_catalog.access_rules: Rental or companion stable; ordinary mounts never require Oath binding.
mode_catalog.constraints: Grade, width, forage, rest, traction and turning radius.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Walk, relief porter or accessible passenger conveyance.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Trade highways
mode_catalog.access_rules: Civic lane protected; tariffs apply to cargo, not relief movement.
mode_catalog.constraints: Axle class, cargo inspection, queue and maintenance.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Parallel foot lane plus geographically separate detour.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Chartered teleportation
mode_catalog.access_rules: Visit both anchors first; pay abstract fare or earn transit voucher; no Oath binding.
mode_catalog.constraints: No combat escape, contraband cargo, siege bypass, private housing entry or unverified destination.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Ordinary route endpoints remain staffed; failed charge refunded; no involuntary displacement.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Storm Relay grounded carriers
mode_catalog.access_rules: Inspected grounded carriage with public operator; binding Storm is not required.
mode_catalog.constraints: Lightning lockout, anchor integrity and charge reserve; no uncontrolled lightning riding.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Sheltered road below the relay span; travel can be slower but never inaccessible.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Escapement Road vehicles
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public timetable, brake inspection and ticket/voucher; no time Oath required.
mode_catalog.constraints: Road capacity, winding reserve and time-stutter boundary; cannot rewind ownership or schedules.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Foot lane outside anomalous timing volume; conventional relief wagon.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Observatory ballast platforms
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public operator, restraints and stable docks; no gravity Oath required.
mode_catalog.constraints: Mass rating, bounded lift volume and emergency ballast; no open-world flight.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Ground stairs/ramps, conventional lift and reachable emergency dock.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: The Missing Court threshold passages
mode_catalog.access_rules: Optional visited-anchor charter with identity check; never arbitrary phasing.
mode_catalog.constraints: Boundary, cooldown, cargo volume and visible reentry; cannot enter locked homes or skip siege conditions.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Physical lit road outside void volume; abort returns to origin.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Swimming and optional diving
mode_catalog.access_rules: Optional ability and safe exit markers; no required underwater civic access.
mode_catalog.constraints: Current, breath, pollution, cold and surf; cannot swim every mapped river.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Bridge, ferry or surfaced walkway; rescue exit always remains on same reachable bank.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Conventional cable lifts
mode_catalog.access_rules: Public inspected cabins; no Oath; accessible boarding.
mode_catalog.constraints: Wind, cable wear, load and rescue power.
mode_catalog.ordinary_fallback: Ground switchback with relief cart; cabins have retrieval protocol.
mode_catalog.measurement_status: Design target; abstract test credits are not a named canon currency, capacity is not benchmarked.

mode_catalog.name: Bounded optional traversal morphs
mode_catalog.access_rules: Explicit opt-in, authored unlock and validated endpoint; never primary story transport.
